_comment: Expected on-wire frames with the proof SOURCE for each (see parity.Status / PARITY.md). Single-source 'firmware'/'app' do NOT clear sending. A command clears to transmit at 'cross' (firmware+app agree), 'stored' (reproduces his real NVM/.rax values), 'passive' (matches a passive connect/read-back sniff) or 'active' (app performing it). The 4 original DSP-write-table entries are single-source firmware (NOT cleared to send). The cap_* passive entries are connect/read/baud. The cap_write_0700_* entries are ACTIVE captures of the official app performing the write; they clear ONLY as byte-exact frames (the exact gain/flag toggles captured), never as a command-level unlock -- arbitrary 0x0700 writes remain gated.

frames.name: cap_write_0700_gain_m0p1
frames.note: 0x0700 channel-property WRITE, LEN4 [preset=00, channel=00, gain_be16=0xeccd]. ACTIVE capture of the official app performing it (USBPcap 2026-10-21). gain 0xeccd -> raw -4915 -> -0.100 dB (display=raw/512+9.5). Part of the user live toggle gain 0.0->-0.1->0.0. Byte-exact vs MdiFramer.

frames.name: cap_write_0700_gain_0p0_len4
frames.note: 0x0700 WRITE, LEN4 [preset=00, channel=00, gain_be16=0xed00]. ACTIVE capture (USBPcap 2026-10-21). gain 0xed00 = unity raw -4864 -> 0.000 dB. Restore step of the live toggle. Byte-exact vs MdiFramer.

frames.name: cap_write_0700_ch11_flag_on
frames.note: 0x0700 WRITE, LEN16 full channel-property record [preset=00, channel=0x0b(11), gain_be16=0xed00=0.0dB, ...flag[8]=01 ON, ...limit_be32=0x7fffffff max]. ACTIVE capture (USBPcap 2026-10-21), flag set-and-undo pair. Byte-exact vs MdiFramer.

frames.name: cap_write_0700_ch11_flag_off
frames.note: 0x0700 WRITE, LEN16 full channel-property record [preset=00, channel=0x0b(11), gain_be16=0xed00=0.0dB, ...flag[8]=00 OFF, ...limit_be32=0x7fffffff]. ACTIVE capture (USBPcap 2026-10-21), the undo of the flag set. Byte-exact vs MdiFramer.

frames.name: cap_write_0700_ch1_gain_m6
frames.note: 0x0700 LEN16 full record, Ch1 gain -6.0 dB. ACTIVE capture 2026-10-22 vehicle session. gain be16 @[2-3]=0xe100 -> (0xe100-0xed00)/512=-6.0. Reproduced byte-exact by channel_record.build_record(1, gain_db=-6.0). Pins gain field offset+endianness.

frames.name: cap_write_0700_ch1_delay_5ms
frames.note: 0x0700 LEN16 full record, Ch1 delay 5.00 ms. ACTIVE capture 2026-10-22. delay be16 @[5-6]=0x1388=5000 us (CONFIRMS delay is bytes 5-6, NOT 6-7). Reproduced byte-exact by channel_record.build_record(1, delay_ms=5.0).

frames.name: cap_write_0700_ch1_limiter_m20
frames.note: 0x0700 LEN16 full record, Ch1 limiter -20.0 dBFS. ACTIVE capture 2026-10-22. limiter i32 @[12-15]=0x0cccccd0 = round(float32(10^(-20/20))*2^31). Reproduced byte-exact by channel_record.build_record(1, limiter_dbfs=-20.0). Pins the float32 amplitude pipeline.

frames.name: cap_write_0704_filter_cheby_150_2000
frames.note: 0x0704 filter-def, Ch1 Chebyshev band 150/2000 Hz 12/12 dB/oct. ACTIVE capture 2026-10-22. payload [sub=03][chan be16=0001][type=03 band][design=04 cheby][f1 be16=0x0096=150][f2 be16=0x07d0=2000][slope1=0x0c=12][slope2=0x0c=12]. NOTE f1/f2 order on wire is f2 then f1: bytes 07d0(2000) then 0096(150). Companion 0x0708 biquad floats NOT yet captured here (on laptop decode) -> coeff math still unproven.

frames.name: cap_write_0704_master_points_empty
frames.note: 0x0704 sub06 MASTERPOINTS, preset 0, zero points (the empty master EQ list). ACTIVE capture of the official app 2026-10-21: sent after every master-gain write (19:33:12.915 gain, 12.931 0x0702 table, 12.995 this frame). Also in reference_frames_full.json at offsets 3211 and 4261, where it was tagged is_write=False by mistake.
